snippet.description:

More recently, she produced a series breaking down how to make songs in the style of Mitski, Frank Ocean, and Tyler, the Creator. Her debut album, You Are Not Alone Enough, is due out later this year.

Nat opens her XOXO talk with a performance of "I Don't Trust U Anymore" off of Transgender Street Legend Vol. 1, and closes with a performance of "I Split My Ribs Open" with surprise special guest, Open Mike Eagle. Both songs can be found on Bandcamp here.
